# IMMUTABLE UPSTREAM LONGPLAY

Source: Hiepler/LongPlay upstream main.

ABSOLUTE RULE: files under vendor/LongPlay are vendor source and MUST NOT be edited for Music for Tesla features, fixes, styling, YouTube integration, QR, filters, recommendations, or experiments.

All project-specific work MUST live outside vendor/LongPlay as overlays/adapters.

If upstream LongPlay needs updating, replace vendor files only from a verified upstream commit and record that upstream commit. Never hand-edit vendor core.


## OWNER-ONLY UNLOCK
The vendor core may be changed, replaced, updated, rebased, patched, or unlocked ONLY after explicit approval from the user/owner in the active conversation.
The assistant must never infer approval, self-authorize, or treat a feature request as permission to alter the core.
Without explicit owner approval: ZERO modifications to vendor/LongPlay.
